title: [Main]]No Employee posting group for AT when new employee is created
summary: An Austrian localization issue where new employees created from templates lacked an employee posting group assignment has been fixed by applying the EMPLEXP posting group to employee templates.
key_points: ADMINISTRATION and IT employee templates in the AT demo data now get an employee posting group
The AT subscriber used to clear the field and now assigns EMPLEXP
Demo employees created from these templates now carry the posting group
quote: No Employee posting group for AT when new employee is created
